entries.question: How far should the #4897 fix go: minimal (add DecisionPoint to preserved set), delegate to is_non_lane_event, or a shared authoritative-non-lane-event-type registry both subsystems consult?
entries.rationale: Operator-chosen (grounding squad + AskUserQuestion): create ONE authoritative-non-lane-event-type registry that both status/store.py:is_non_lane_event and the mission_state repair (_is_preserved_non_lane_row) consult, closing the recurring whack-a-field class (#2376/#3066/#3541) by construction rather than adding another hand-maintained preserved-set entry.
